events.note:

His wife Katarzyna is described as residing in Turze, meaning Philip made the journey solo.

notes:
From Dennis Lacho's genealogy database:

Helper at CPR and resided with William at 382 Garlies Street in
1947 ??
Shown in the 1972 Henderson's Directory as being retired with his
wife Kath at 805 Leola Street, Winnipeg, Manitoba.
Obituary appears in Winnipeg Free Press on June 9 and Saturday,
June 11, 1983 on page 46:
Died after a lengthy illness at the age of 82 years.
Resided at 805 Leola Street in Transcona, Manitoba.
Born in Poland, came to Canada at an early age.
Philip was employed with the CNR until he retired in 1965 at the age
of 65 years.
Predeceased by his wife Katherine on June 11, 1917.
Survived by daughter Sophie/Michael Hoshko, sons John / Mary and
Peter of Transcona, and grandsons Jim and Michael Hoshko, and
brother John of Winnipeg.
Prayers were said Sunday, June 12, 1983 at the Transcona Funeral
Chapel, 1800 Day Street, Transcona (Winnipeg), Manitoba.
Service was held Monday, June 13, 1983 at the chapel, with Rev. Fr.
M.J. Buyachok officiating.
According to Sophie Hoshko, (per conversation of April 30., 1998), her
father came to Canada in 1929, the rest of the family came in 1937,
and Philip's brother John came after WW II.
